description: Expected getImagePaints(i) for every page of the listed fixtures: the paints in paint order, or the error code when the page's content cannot be read. Checked in Node, in a browser page and in a Web Worker (test/scenarios/paint-scenarios.mjs). The matrices are worked out by hand from the content streams in generate-fixtures.mjs, never taken from the binary.

conventions.ref: object number of the painted image XObject; fixtures number their objects from 1 in the order generate-fixtures.mjs lists them
conventions.matrix: [a b c d e f]: the current transformation matrix at the Do operator. `m cm` replaces the CTM by m x CTM; a form XObject is drawn with its /Matrix x CTM
conventions.error: ErrorCode of a failed getImagePaints(i); the other pages of the document are unaffected

simple-one-image.pdf.description: One image, drawn once inside q ... Q.

multi-image.pdf.description: Two images on page 0, one on page 1.

nested-forms.pdf.description: An image on the page and one inside a form XObject without /Matrix, drawn at [200 0 0 200 250 400].

smask-pair.pdf.description: A picture with a soft mask: the picture is painted, the mask (6) is not an operand of Do.

shared-image-3-pages.pdf.description: Three pages share one content stream and one image.

inherited-resources-3-pages.pdf.description: All three pages inherit a resource dictionary naming the image; only pages 0 and 2 paint it.

user-unit.pdf.description: No images; /UserUnit is a page fact and does not change the matrices.

paint-transforms.pdf.description: cm concatenates, q/Q save and restore (nested), a rotation by 90 degrees; images painted several times. Im1 = 5, Im2 = 6.

paint-forms.pdf.description: Fm1 (/Matrix [2 0 0 2 0 0]) drawn at [1 0 0 1 100 200] and at [3 0 0 3 0 0]; inside it Im1 (8), the nested Fm2 with Im2 (9), and Im1 again (Fm2's cm does not leak). Then Fm3 (/Matrix [1 0 0 1 7 9], no /Resources: page resources) and Im1 on the page (Fm1's unbalanced q ... cm does not leak).

paint-content-tolerance.pdf.description: /Contents array of two streams (graphics state carries over), a Q without q, Do of a missing name, of a /PS XObject and of a string, an inline image. Painted: Im1 (6) and the stencil mask (9). Im2 (7) is a resource that is never painted.

paint-malformed-operands.pdf.description: cm with four numbers (page 0), with a name among its operands (page 1), with seven numbers (page 2); page 3 is well-formed.

paint-unreadable-forms.pdf.description: A form that draws itself (page 0), two forms that draw each other (page 1), a form /Matrix of four numbers (page 2), 1,111,110 XObject draws (page 3); page 4 draws a well-formed form with Im1 (23).

paint-unreadable-content.pdf.description: A content stream with damaged Flate data (page 0), one with an unterminated string (page 1); page 2 is well-formed.
